messages:
Nadia H: Morning team - quick tasking for the Plume launch week: finalizing launch posts, benchmark narrative, webinar landing schema, internal linking plan, and redirects. Need everything in a tidy checklist by Thu AM.

Jon T: I can take internal linking + anchor map for the three launch posts. Priya will own schema + structured data. Nadia - can you confirm the launch post slugs?

Nadia H: slugs = /plume-low-latency, /plume-benchmarks, /plume-webinar-recap. Also one evergreen guide -> /plume-best-practices.

Priya S: schema plan: add Event + FAQPage on the webinar landing, Article + mainEntity for posts, and speakerview Person markup for speakers. Will draft JSON-LD and share.

Jon T: internal linking matrix - propose anchors: "low-latency inference", "inference costs", "benchmark results", "webinar recording". Ill map anchors to CTAs and canonical pages.

Sam (deploy-bot): Reminder - redirect CSV must be `source,target,type`. Use 301 for permanent.

Olivia (seo-bot): Note - duplicate meta titles detected between /plume-low-latency and /plume-benchmarks. Recommend title tweak to avoid cannibalization.

Nadia H: good catch. Change /plume-low-latency title to "Plume: Low-latency inference at scale" and keep benchmarks as "Plume benchmark results".

Priya S: JSON-LD draft pasted below. Please review for speaker names and dates.

Priya S: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@graph":[{"@type":"Event","name":"Plume Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-14T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://www.redwood.ai/plume-webinar"}},{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Plume?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Plume is Redwood's low-latency inference config..."}}]}]}
```

Jon T: linking plan uploaded to drive: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/PLUME-ANCHORS. I've flagged 6 internal redirects that could be consolidated.

Nadia H: acceptance criteria: redirects uploaded to s3, schema added to landing + top-2 posts, internal links live in copy, titles deconflicted, and sitemap updated.

Priya S: also recommend adding structured data test step: run rich results test and report screenshot.

Sam (deploy-bot): To deploy redirects: `/deploy redirects plume-2026` once file in `s3://redwood-deploy/redirects/`. I'll post success/fail.

Olivia (seo-bot): Post checklist: 1) sitemap include /plume*; 2) submit sitemap to Search Console; 3) check mobile-first render for microdata.

Nadia H: team, drop a 1-line status in the sheet by EOD. We'll reconvene 10:30am Thu if blockers. Thanks! :sparkles:
